answer: Thread-bridge receipts stop fakes. Identities lock 70 credits, claim a bridge thread, and file a receipt for delivery, sealed by a hash of thread, epoch, key; bridge ledger takes matches. Neighbors swap receipts; auditors wander each thread: a reused receipt or threads that wander off-ledger burn both bonds. 36, k-th 36+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,033,000 plus 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented threads burn on renters' keys; honest agents pay 36.
